definitions.gloss: eating moderately; dietary restraint; restricting one's diet
definitions.explanation: The practice of deliberately eating less or controlling one's food intake for health reasons.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}のために{節食|せっしょく}している。
examples.english: I'm restricting my diet for my health.

examples.japanese: {医者|いしゃ}に{節食|せっしょく}を{勧|すす}められた。
{無理|むり}な{節食|せっしょく}は{体|からだ}に{悪|わる}いので、バランスの{良|よ}い{食事|しょくじ}を{心|こころ}がけている。
examples.english: Since extreme dieting is bad for the body, I try to eat a well-balanced diet.

notes:
A compound of {節|せつ} (moderation/restraint) and {食|しょく} (eating/food). Implies a deliberate, health-conscious reduction in food intake, not starvation. More formal and measured than ダイエット, which in Japanese broadly means any weight-loss effort. {節食|せっしょく} focuses specifically on moderating food quantity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {節食|せっしょく}する: to restrict one's diet
- {節食|せっしょく}を{心|こころ}がける: to make an effort to eat moderately
- {無理|むり}な{節食|せっしょく}: excessive dietary restriction
- {節食|せっしょく}と{運動|うんどう}: diet and exercise

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ダイエット: diet, weight loss — broader, includes exercise and lifestyle changes
- {食事制限|しょくじせいげん}: dietary restriction — more clinical, often medically prescribed
- {減食|げんしょく}: reducing food intake — similar meaning, slightly more direct
- {断食|だんじき}: fasting — complete abstention from food, much more extreme
